sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: TeraWulf Drops 4% on Profit Taking After a 44% YTD Run; Applied Digital Falls 3%, IREN Pulls Back
feed.summary: Shares of TeraWulf, Applied Digital, and IREN experienced drops on Thursday due to profit-taking after significant year-to-date gains, with no new company news or analyst downgrades to explain the decline. This pullback is seen as a group rotation rather than broad tech weakness, especially as the Bitcoin mining ETF WGMI also fell while the broader Nasdaq 100 showed only minor weakness. Analysts remain positive on TeraWulf, with a recent Buy rating and a $19 target, and its substantial 20-year deal with Anthropic remains intact, suggesting the underlying investment thesis for these AI-infrastructure companies is still strong.

feed.title: Building the Future: Why Galaxy is Sponsoring a Solana DAT
feed.summary: Galaxy Digital is sponsoring a Solana Digital Asset Treasury (DAT), underscoring its belief in blockchain as the future foundation of global markets and specifically Solana's capacity for institutional-grade financial activity. This initiative involves a $1.65 billion private placement in Forward Industries Inc. to create the world's largest Solana digital asset treasury, aiming for active alpha generation through staking, lending, and advanced Solana-native strategies. The company highlights Solana's leading performance metrics, developer growth, and its unique position to accelerate institutional adoption with the backing of Galaxy, Jump Crypto, and Multicoin Capital.

feed.title: BurgerFi International declares Chapter 11 bankruptcy
feed.summary: BurgerFi International has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after experiencing significant sales and earnings losses. The company, which owns BurgerFi and Anthony’s Coal-Fired Pizza, has been struggling with deepening financial issues, reporting an $18.4 million net loss in the most recent quarter. A sale of the company is anticipated, with TREW Capital Management, which previously acquired Rubio's out of bankruptcy, having already bought BurgerFi's debt.

feed.title: Cushman & Wakefield (NYSE:CWK) Insider Nathaniel Robinson Sells 12,500 Shares of Stock

This transaction reduced his holding by 17.64% to 58,376 shares. The company's stock experienced a 3.8% decline, trading at $12.66, and analysts currently rate it as a "Moderate Buy" with a consensus target price of $17.57.

feed.title: Insider Buying: Cross Timbers Royalty Trust (NYSE:CRT) Major Shareholder Purchases 7,134 Shares of Stock

The purchase was made at an average price of $11.29 per share. The company has also announced an increased monthly dividend of $0.0679 per share, equating to a 7.2% annualized yield despite a payout ratio of 152.83%.

feed.title: Barclays conference: Chevron sees Venezuela as a factory development; Exxon says operators matter more than ever
feed.summary: At the Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference, Chevron discussed its $7-billion investment plan in Venezuela, aiming for a "factory-type" development to reach 600,000 b/d by 2031 from existing infrastructure. ExxonMobil highlighted its "once-in-a-lifetime" opportunity in Guyana, emphasizing that operator quality is increasingly important to resource owners. Both companies detailed their strategies for future upstream growth and resource development.

feed.title: Citigroup Issues Positive Forecast for Darden Restaurants (NYSE:DRI) Stock Price
feed.summary: Citigroup has raised its price target for Darden Restaurants (NYSE:DRI) from $245 to $248, maintaining a "buy" rating and suggesting an 18.51% upside. This positive forecast comes after Darden reported strong quarterly earnings, with EPS slightly above consensus and revenue up 13.7% year-over-year. The company has also issued optimistic fiscal 2027 EPS guidance, contributing to a "Moderate Buy" consensus among analysts with an average target of $230.79.

feed.title: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) Raises the Bar After A Strong Quarter
feed.summary: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) is gaining market attention due to strong quarterly execution, resilient beauty demand, and an improved fiscal outlook. The company's performance, marked by better-than-expected sales and earnings, is driven by comparable-store momentum, new store openings, international expansion, and a diverse merchandise mix. Ulta Beauty's strategy emphasizes a connected shopping experience through its physical stores and digital ecosystem, robust loyalty programs, and brand variety to navigate a competitive and evolving retail landscape.

feed.title: 3 paper packaging CEOs talk market volatility, pricing
feed.summary: CEOs from Packaging Corporation of America, International Paper, and Graphic Packaging International discussed the significant impact of economic and geopolitical disruptions on the paper and packaging industry, leading to market volatility and cost inflation. Companies are responding with price increases and cost-cutting measures, while also navigating challenges like fluctuating demand and agricultural sector issues. Despite these hurdles, they are focused on optimizing operations and building platforms for future growth.

feed.title: New Mexico restaurants face authenticity debate as small business AI adoption speeds up - Albuquerque Business First
feed.summary: A new study by JPMorgan Chase reveals a rapid increase in AI adoption among small businesses, particularly in the restaurant industry. While AI helps with tasks like forecasting and inventory management, there's a growing debate about the authenticity of AI-generated marketing content and its potential to alienate local customers. The article highlights both the benefits and potential drawbacks as small businesses in New Mexico integrate AI into their operations.

feed.title: NEE Stock Trades at a Premium Valuation: Buy, Hold or Stay Away?
feed.summary: NextEra Energy (NEE) currently trades at a premium valuation compared to its industry peers, driven by strong operational performance and growing demand for its services, particularly in Florida and renewable energy. While the company demonstrates consistent performance, positive earnings estimate revisions, and a solid return on equity, its high valuation suggests that new investors might want to wait for a more favorable entry point. The article outlines factors supporting NEE's growth, such as increasing electricity demand, renewable energy expansion, data center opportunities, and strategic partnerships, alongside its strong capital return program.

feed.title: AI fears have hit this data stock. Investor Sarat Sethi sees a buying opportunity
feed.summary: Investor Sarat Sethi views the recent sell-off in Verisk Analytics (VRSK) as a buying opportunity, despite market concerns about AI disruption and slowing growth. Sethi highlights Verisk's strong proprietary data advantage, recurring revenue, high profitability, and discounted valuation as key reasons for his bullish outlook. He believes the current slowdown is temporary and the company's unique position in the insurance industry makes it more resilient than perceived.

feed.title: Tungsten Automation Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Intelligent Document Processing
feed.summary: Tungsten Automation has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), marking its second consecutive year in this position. The company attributes this achievement to its ability to deliver production-ready AI for document processing at enterprise scale, coupled with agentic orchestration and governance. Tungsten Automation's flagship platform, TotalAgility™, processes over 10 billion documents annually for major organizations across various sectors, highlighting its significant impact and trusted solutions in document automation.

feed.title: Delta flight to Phoenix returns to JFK amid 'possible pressurization issue'
feed.summary: Delta Flight 791, en route from New York-JFK to Phoenix, returned to John F. Kennedy International Airport after a possible cabin pressurization issue. The Boeing 757-200, carrying 155 passengers and 6 crew members, landed safely, and passengers were later transferred to a new aircraft to continue their journey. Both the FAA and Delta confirmed the incident, stating standard procedures were followed.

feed.title: CWT Unit Gets Rate Hike Nod to Recover Infrastructure Investments
feed.summary: California Water Service Group's (CWT) unit, Washington Water, received approval for new water rates, expected to increase annual revenues by $4.1 million to recover costs from infrastructure investments totaling $26.5 million. This approval highlights CWT's ongoing focus on infrastructure spending and regulatory cost recovery, with the company investing significantly in utility plant and forecasting substantial capital expenditures for 2026. Rate hikes are crucial for utilities to fund capital-intensive operations, maintain and upgrade aging systems, and support reliable service and water quality improvements.

feed.title: Chemours, DuPont, Corteva reach $455 PFAS settlement with North Carolina
feed.summary: Chemours, DuPont, and Corteva have agreed to a $455 million settlement with North Carolina to resolve PFAS contamination claims from Chemours' Fayetteville Works facility. The settlement allocates $380 million to 10 counties and municipalities, and establishes a $135 million reserve fund from DuPont and Corteva in case Chemours faces bankruptcy. This agreement, which includes no admission of liability, also aims to mitigate future environmental impacts and ensure clean water supplies for affected residents.

feed.title: StandardAero stock hits 52-week low at 23.81 USD By Investing.com
feed.summary: StandardAero Inc.'s stock recently hit a 52-week low of $23.81, reflecting a 12.76% decline over the past year. Despite this downturn, InvestingPro data suggests the stock may be undervalued with a PEG ratio of 0.18, and analysts have revised earnings upwards. The company also reported strong Q2 revenue and adjusted earnings, maintaining an Outperform rating from Bernstein SocGen Group.

feed.title: Capital City Bank Group declares $0.27 quarterly dividend By Investing.com
feed.summary: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:CCBG) has announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share on its common stock. The dividend is scheduled for payment on September 22, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 8, 2026, representing an annualized yield of 2.11% based on a recent closing stock price. The company, a financial holding entity based in Florida, manages approximately $4.5 billion in assets through its subsidiary Capital City Bank.

feed.title: Can Strong End-Market Demand Boost Carpenter Technology's Growth?
feed.summary: Carpenter Technology (CRS) is experiencing significant growth driven by strong demand in its aerospace and defense markets, with sales up 15% in fiscal 2026. The company is also seeing an uptick in Industrial, Consumer, and Transportation sectors, offsetting a slight dip in Medical. With robust booking growth and favorable market trends, Carpenter Technology projects strong operating income growth for fiscal years 2027 and 2029.

feed.title: NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) Stock Price Up 6% - Here's What Happened
feed.summary: NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) shares increased by 6% to approximately $194.63, driven by strong investor momentum and an upgrade from Zacks to "Strong Buy." The company's recent quarterly earnings surpassed expectations with an EPS of $2.58 and revenue of $2.03 billion, reflecting a 29.9% year-over-year increase. Analysts have revised earnings forecasts upwards, yet the broader consensus remains "Hold" with a target price close to the current trading level.

feed.title: Can American Tower (NYSE:AMT) Keep Its Momentum?
feed.summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) is attracting market attention due to strong quarterly performance, resilient demand for communications infrastructure, financing activities, and shifting interest rates. The company benefits from its extensive portfolio of wireless towers and a recurring site-leasing model, which underpins its stable business model even amid economic changes. Future performance will be shaped by wireless carrier activity, interest rates, debt management, and the expansion of its distributed communications systems.

feed.title: GE HealthCare, Leo Cancer Care to Collaborate on Imaging, Radiation Therapy Workflows
feed.summary: GE HealthCare and Leo Cancer Care are partnering to integrate advanced imaging solutions and Intelligent Radiation Therapy (iRT) software with Leo Cancer Care's future upright radiation therapy. This collaboration aims to create more connected patient and data workflows, addressing challenges like interoperability, fragmented clinical processes, and access to technology in radiation oncology. The goal is to simplify workflows and reduce the time from imaging to treatment through a patient-centered approach.

feed.title: Tractor Supply Co. to expand Triad footprint after buying land from prominent restaurateur
feed.summary: Tractor Supply Co. has purchased five acres of undeveloped land in Winston-Salem for just under a million dollars, expanding its presence in the Triad area. The property was sold by a prominent local restaurant owner. This acquisition will add to Tractor Supply Co.'s existing 20 stores in the Triad.

feed.title: Microsoft comms chief Frank Shaw to exit after nearly three decades shaping the company's message
feed.summary: Frank X. Shaw, Microsoft's chief communications officer, is set to leave the company at the end of the year after nearly three decades of shaping its message. Shaw, 64, does not have another job lined up and plans to take a break before deciding on his next move. He was instrumental in navigating Microsoft through significant periods, including antitrust challenges, CEO transitions, and the company's recent AI push under Satya Nadella.

feed.title: BR Stock Rises 16.1% in 3 Months: Here's What You Should Know
feed.summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (BR) stock has increased by 16.1% over the past three months, outperforming the S&P 500. This growth is attributed to its high recurring revenue visibility, strong client retention, expanding operating margins, and robust cash flow that supports capital returns. The company also anticipates productivity savings from AI, further contributing to its positive outlook.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against Celsius Holdings, Inc. (CELH) and certain officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The lawsuit claims that Celsius made false and misleading statements and/or failed to disclose cardiac risks associated with their "Alani Nu" products and targeted underage consumers. Investors who purchased Celsius securities between February 21, 2023, and June 3, 2024, are encouraged to join the case by November 3, 2026.

feed.title: Moderna Rallies 8% on 2026 Melt-Up Momentum Even While BioNTech and Merck Stay Flat
feed.summary: Moderna (NASDAQ: MRNA) stock surged 8% despite no specific news, trial readouts, or analyst calls, while its peers BioNTech and Merck remained flat or slightly down. This unexpected rally follows a 143% gain over the past month due to a successful late-stage melanoma trial in August. The current surge is likely driven by momentum buying or a short squeeze, as broader market and sector movements do not account for Moderna's stock-specific event.

feed.title: Moderna Rallies 8% on 2026 Melt-Up Momentum Even While BioNTech and Merck Stay Flat
feed.summary: Moderna (MRNA) stock surged 8% despite its biotech peers BioNTech and Merck remaining largely flat, suggesting a stock-specific event rather than a sector-wide trend. The rally comes after Moderna had already seen a 143% increase in the past month due to a successful late-stage melanoma trial in August, with no new clinical or regulatory triggers for Friday's jump. Analysts suggest the movement is likely due to momentum buying or a short squeeze, given the absence of new fundamental news.

feed.title: Franklin Templeton Announces Distributions for Certain Closed-End Funds Pursuant to their Managed Distribution Policy for the Month of September 2026
feed.summary: Franklin Templeton has announced distributions for several of its closed-end funds for September 2026, in line with their managed distribution policy. Funds like Templeton Dragon Fund Inc. (TDF) and Templeton Emerging Markets Fund (EMF) will pay out specified amounts to shareholders on September 30, 2026. The policy aims to maintain consistent distribution levels using income, capital gains, or return of capital, with the understanding that these distributions do not necessarily reflect investment performance and can be modified by the Board of Directors.

feed.title: Q&A: ‘Opine with the spine’: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder on leading through the AI shift
feed.summary: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder discusses how she is leading the software giant through the AI shift with a new brand campaign, "The World is Yours for the Making," which emphasizes human creativity. She explains her approach to marketing, highlighting the emotional aspect of B2B purchases and the importance of supporting her global marketing team through technological advancements. Treseder also shares insights from her diverse CMO experience at Peloton, GE, and Carbon, emphasizing curiosity, conviction, and courage.

feed.title: Cruising gluten-free: Inside Royal Caribbean’s Celiac Cruise experience
feed.summary: This article details Julia's positive experience on a Royal Caribbean Celiac Cruise after her celiac disease diagnosis made travel challenging. The cruise, partnered with Celiac Cruise, offers dedicated gluten-free dining spaces, trained staff, and special wristbands to ensure a worry-free vacation for guests with celiac disease. The program has been very successful, leading to expansion and even inspiring Oceania Cruises to offer a similar entirely gluten-free voyage.

feed.title: Why This Apple Supplier Is on Pace for Its Best 5-Day Stretch in 17 Years
feed.summary: Skyworks Solutions, an Apple supplier, is experiencing its best five-day stock performance in 17 years. This surge occurred after CEO Philip Brace provided an update to investors regarding a crucial merger. The stock closed higher for the fifth consecutive trading session on Friday.

feed.summary: Cheetah Mobile Inc. (CMCM) reported its Q2 2026 financial results, with adjusted earnings of -¥0.06 per share and revenue of ¥266.1M, which was in line with estimates but down 9.9% year-over-year. The company posted a net loss of ¥86.9M, while its cloud and AI infrastructure revenue showed significant growth of 83.1%. Wall Street consensus includes 0 buy, 2 hold, and 1 sell ratings for CMCM.

feed.title: FutureMain Co., ltd. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger and Business Combination Agreement to acquire ChampionsGate Acquisition Corporation in a reverse merger transaction for an enterprise value of $80 million.
feed.summary: FutureMain Co., ltd. has entered into a reverse merger agreement to acquire ChampionsGate Acquisition Corporation for an enterprise value of $80 million. The transaction involves shareholders of Holdco receiving shares of Pubco, valued at $10.00 per share, and is expected to close in 2027, pending regulatory and shareholder approvals. FocalPoint Asia served as the financial advisor for FutureMain.

feed.title: Canadian Natural Resources (TSX:CNQ) Climbs To Fresh Yearly High
feed.summary: Canadian Natural Resources (TSX:CNQ) reached a new yearly high before a slight pullback, indicating sustained momentum. Analysts hold mixed sentiments, with a lean towards favorable outlooks but a cautious collective target price. The company's recent quarterly results show strong profitability and efficient operations, driven by its diversified asset base and significant scale in the energy sector.

feed.title: SMCI or NTAP: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
feed.summary: This article compares Super Micro Computer (SMCI) and NetApp (NTAP) as potential value stock investments, both currently holding a Zacks Rank of #1 (Strong Buy). Analyzing valuation metrics like P/E, PEG, and P/B ratios, the article concludes that SMCI appears to be the superior value option with stronger metrics compared to NTAP.

feed.title: Arcturus Therapeutics at cantoral global healthcare conference: data catalysts ahead
feed.summary: Arcturus Therapeutics presented at the 12th Annual Cantor Fitzgerald Global Healthcare Conference, highlighting its pipeline with three key programs: an OTC deficiency therapy, an inhaled cystic fibrosis treatment, and a self-amplifying mRNA platform. The company anticipates several critical data readouts and decisions, including Phase II data for its OTC deficiency program and a Q4 decision on its cystic fibrosis treatment, which could unlock significant funding. Arcturus emphasized its differentiated technology, strong safety profiles, and strategic partnerships as it aims to address unmet medical needs and generate non-dilutive funding.

feed.title: Megan Terrell Puts People at the Center of Analytics
feed.summary: Megan Terrell, People Analytics Manager at Howmet Aerospace Inc., focuses on integrating technology with a people-centric approach to HR metrics and predictive modeling. Terrell, who moved to Pittsburgh in 2021, emphasizes community building, mentorship, and empowering individuals alongside technological advancements like AI. Her work extends to significant community involvement, including co-founding Howmet’s Outdoor Club, leading the Howmet Women’s Network, and fundraising for local charities, reflecting her belief that surrounding oneself with positive inputs dictates positive outputs.

feed.title: Bank7 Corp. Boosts Century Financial Acquisition Offer to $88.96 Million After Court Auction
feed.summary: Bank7 Corp. has increased its acquisition offer for Century Financial Services Corporation to $88.96 million after winning a court-supervised auction with a $91 million bid. The revised price reflects a $2.04 million break-up fee credit. The deal, which covers approximately 71% of Century's common stock, is contingent on court and regulatory approvals.

feed.title: AI Data Centers Need Enormous Amounts of Power: These 5 Dividend Stocks Provide It
feed.summary: The article highlights five dividend utility stocks poised to benefit from the massive power demands of AI data centers. Companies like Southern Company, Duke Energy, WEC Energy Group, Xcel Energy, and Consolidated Edison are expanding their infrastructure to meet this growing demand, turning capital expenditures into predictable earnings and steady dividends. Each company offers unique advantages and risks, catering to different investment strategies focused on income durability or growth potential.

feed.title: General Mills saw base pricing reduction as ‘biggest issue’
feed.summary: General Mills executives discussed their decision to lower base prices as a pivotal move at the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference. This strategy, aimed at addressing pricing gaps and improving value, led to improved results, including stabilized base volume and growth in household penetration for most categories. Despite a slower-than-expected volume recovery and the need to fix underperforming brands, the company is confident in its position for future growth as it shifts focus to innovation.

feed.title: Cathay General Bancorp CFO Albert Jen-Wen Wang Vests 4,012 Restricted Stock Units and Sells Shares for Tax Withholding
feed.summary: Cathay General Bancorp CFO Albert Jen-Wen Wang vested 4,012 restricted stock units on September 8, 2026. Simultaneously, 1,294 shares were sold at $61.86 each to cover tax withholding obligations. Following these transactions, Wang directly holds 2,718 shares of the company's common stock.

feed.title: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce : Publication of Second Amended Final Terms (XS3435397115, SPUK 126)
feed.summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce has published its Second Amended Final Terms for Index Linked Interest and Redemption Notes due September 2033 (XS3435397115, SPUK 126). These terms detail the contractual conditions, interest payment structure linked to the S&P 500® and EURO STOXX 50® indices, and redemption provisions for the GBP 250,000 issue. The document also outlines regulatory compliance, target market information, and disclaimers regarding the underlying indices.

feed.title: Accountability, oversight and AI: Inside Microsoft’s security transformation
feed.summary: After enduring several high-profile cyberattacks, Microsoft launched its Secure Future Initiative (SFI) in November 2023 to transform its cybersecurity approach. The initiative emphasizes cultural change, accountability, and the integration of AI scanning tools like MDASH to identify vulnerabilities early in the development process. Microsoft is also implementing secure-by-default policies and requiring multifactor authentication for Azure, indicating a significant shift towards prioritizing security across its products and operations.

feed.title: Cisco (CSCO) Down 5.3% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
feed.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) shares have dropped 5.3% since its last earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500, but the company's Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings beat estimates with strong networking revenue growth. The company reported non-GAAP earnings of $1.22 per share and revenues of $17.252 billion, driven by broad networking demand and significant growth in AI infrastructure orders. Despite a decline in gross margin, operating margin expanded, and Cisco provided a strong outlook for fiscal 2027, projecting revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion and non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share.

feed.title: Kaplan Fox is Investigating Possible Securities Law Violations Against Cellebrite DI Ltd. (NASDAQ: CLBT)
feed.summary: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP is investigating potential securities law violations against Cellebrite DI Ltd. (NASDAQ: CLBT) following a significant drop in its stock price. This investigation comes after Cellebrite reported second-quarter results that missed revenue projections, cut full-year guidance, and announced an abrupt CEO change, leading to a 29% stock price decline on August 13, 2026. The firm is encouraging affected investors to contact them for more information regarding the investigation.
